info.name: Dendrites API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Dendrites AI Learning Companion.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:5000/api/v1

Authentication: httpOnly cookies (accessToken + refreshToken) set automatically on login/register.

item.name: 🔮 [PLANNED] Suggestions
item.description: 🔜 PLANNED: Inline query prediction and autocomplete using vector similarity + prefix matching.

request.description: 🔜 PLANNED: Get inline query suggestions as the user types. Uses a hybrid approach: 1) Prefix match against recent user messages in the current chat + branch ancestors, 2) Vector similarity search against the user's historical queries across all chats. Returns ranked suggestions sorted by relevance. Should be debounced (300ms) on the frontend.
